# Request Eagle

> Request Eagle is a native, open-source API client for macOS, Windows and Linux: a Postman alternative written in Rust that keeps requests as Git-friendly TOML files on your disk, with scripts, Vim mode and a CLI for agents.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/): What Request Eagle is and what it can do
- [Download](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/downloads/): The latest stable release for Apple Silicon Macs, Windows, and Debian or Ubuntu
- [Docs](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/): The guides below

## Guides

- [Request scripts](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/scripting/): Pre-request and post-response JavaScript with the `pm` API
- [Collection Runner](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/collection-runner/): Run a collection's requests in order, with iterations and data files
- [Flows](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/flows/): Chain saved requests on a canvas, with branches and loops
- [Git](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/git/): Track, commit, pull and push collections from the app
- [Agent](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/agent/): The agent panel for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
- [CLI](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/docs/cli/): The command-line interface for agents, without the desktop app
- [Source code](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle): The repository on GitHub
